content_of_post_to_comment: While I was working brutal hours on a mariculture farm, long distance from my then-fiancee-now-wife while we waited for a decision on her K-1 visa, she expressed real concern that I had no friends and did nothing but work. To alleviate her worry, I first got a second job as a bartender, which she felt was just further manifestation of my workaholism, though I did meet very cool people and sate some of the need to just talk to someone other than a bioreactor containing five million larval clams. Then she moved the goalposts to “I need you to do something that doesn’t make any money. Something you cannot possibly monetize.” I’m not saying this is the cure to the loneliness epidemic, but I fucked around on Facebook for a while, found a local improv show that included a “jam” afterwards, attended, jammed, and years later we had like six incredibly funny speeches at our standing room only backyard wedding. And I never made a cent.
